content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to infer from available data? Possibly we need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. But we don't know the compound. Maybe the system expects us to request IR spectra (which is cheap) to count carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool. That returns IR spectrum string with peaks. We can count C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. Let's call tool.
